justification: Data insertion script for gap-fill controls across 7 councils (21 rows). No schema changes, no frontend changes. Uses established insert pattern with dedup check. NULL value_min rows for councils with performance-based DCPs or inaccessible PDFs (needs_review=TRUE for 8 rows).

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_setback_controls table — checked existing rows for each (lga, control_type, dev_type) combo. All 21 are new gaps.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Both value_min and value_max columns used: Strathfield landscaping_min has value_min=10, value_max=45 (lot-size range). Script handles dual-column INSERT at lines 278-288.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: All 21 rows are new. Dedup check prevents duplicates on re-run.

functions.name: main
functions.output: INSERT 21 rows into dcp_setback_controls, committed on success
functions.if_none: If DATABASE_URL is None, psycopg2.connect raises OperationalError

values.nullable: yes — NULL for 17 of 21 rows (performance-based, LEP-controlled, or PDF inaccessible)
values.guard_at: DB columns allow NULL. condition + source_text contain human-readable DCP position.
values.if_missing: Row stored with NULL value, condition/source_text explains DCP position

values.nullable: no — NOT NULL constraint in DB

queries.purpose: Dedup check — skip rows that already exist
queries.where_clause: lga = %s AND control_type = %s AND dev_type = %s AND condition LIKE %s AND is_current = TRUE
queries.if_zero: Row is new — proceed with INSERT
queries.if_wrong: False positive on condition prefix could skip legitimate row — mitigated by 30-char prefix uniqueness
Wrong value or source_text would serve incorrect data — mitigated by verified DCP citations for verified rows, needs_review flag for unverified

break_it.scenario: Strathfield landscaping_min range (10-45%) confuses frontend expecting single value
break_it.what_happens: Frontend might display 10% when lot is >1500m2 (should be 45%)
break_it.how: value_min=10, value_max=45 stored in separate columns. condition text explains full lot-size tiers. Frontend shows condition text alongside values.

break_it.scenario: needs_review rows with NULL values served as 'no requirement' when DCP actually has a numeric rate
break_it.what_happens: User might think no control exists when Leichhardt/Marrickville do have numeric controls locked in scanned PDFs
break_it.how: needs_review=TRUE + review_reason explains PDF extraction blocker. condition text says 'value not yet extracted' or 'scanned image'. 8 of 21 rows flagged.

break_it.scenario: Dedup check fails causing duplicate rows on re-run
break_it.what_happens: User sees double controls for same council/type
break_it.how: Line 272: dedup SELECT on 5-field key. Exception at line 310, conn.rollback() prevents partial insert.

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — spot-check: SELECT lga, control_type, value_min, value_max, needs_review, condition FROM dcp_setback_controls WHERE lga IN ('ryde','canada_bay','strathfield','burwood','ashfield','leichhardt','marrickville') AND control_type IN ('deep_soil_min','max_site_coverage','landscaping_min','front_setback','rear_setback') AND is_current = TRUE ORDER BY lga, control_type;
